title: Angelic Embrace in Surreal Realm
description: Three winged angelic figures with crowns and halos embrace in the foreground, one with mouth open as if singing, set against a vibrant swirling sky. In the background, a white dragon coils around a castle on a hill while a traveler with a staff and circular device stands in a field of purple flowers.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with three embracing winged angels wearing ornate crowns and halos in the foreground, one with mouth open, large feathered wings and flowers, set in a purple flower field with a winding path. In the background a white dragon coils around a castle atop a dark mountain under a swirling colorful sky with two glowing yellow angels. A traveler with backpack and circular staff stands on the right, intricate line art with vibrant psychedelic colors.
